narrative: Your loan application was carefully reviewed by our machine learning model, which analyzes patterns from past credit decisions in 1970s Germany to predict risks for new applicants like you. Based on details such as your checking account showing a negative balance under 0 DM, your credit history of no credits or all paid, a request for 1,082 DM to buy a new car over 12 months, and other factors like your 48 years of age, 4 years at your current residence, ownership of your home, skilled official job, and status as a foreign worker, the model assessed your profile. It calculated an 81% probability that you represent a bad credit risk, meaning it sees a high chance you might struggle to repay, leading to the denial of your application. The three biggest factors pushing this prediction toward denial were your checking account status, credit history, and the purpose of the loan. Your negative checking account balance stood out strongly as a warning sign, since successful applicants rarely have this—only about 20% do, and half have no overdraft at all. Similarly, your credit history of no credits or all paid was a major concern, as it's uncommon among those approved, where over 50% have existing paid credits and fewer than 3% share your exact history. Even the purpose of financing a new car contributed to the risk perception, though it's somewhat common (about 20% of approvals), it combined poorly with your other details in the model's view. Compared to typical approved applicants—who request around 2,887 DM on average, have longer credit durations of about 19 months, and lower installment rates (yours at 4% exceeds their 2.9% average)—your smaller, shorter-term request still raised flags due to these top issues. Positively, elements like owning your home and having no other debtors helped pull slightly toward approval, but not enough to offset the concerns. To improve your chances next time, consider building a more established credit history with smaller, successfully repaid loans, improving your checking account balance, and perhaps saving more (your under-100 DM savings aligns with many approvals but didn't help here). You might also explore purposes like radio/TV or furniture, which are more common among approvals, or extend the loan duration. We recommend discussing with a financial advisor to strengthen these areas before reapplying.
